**Commit**: `574180b653e0` — docs(sweep): consolidated triage — three filings today had a real symptom and a wrong cause

**Body**:

Third and consolidating sweep of the day. Supersedes both earlier ones: the first was
written against an unmerged PR #80, the second before D1/D2/F20 were ratified and executed.

THE FINDING WORTH CARRYING FORWARD is not any single item. Three of today's filings — #74,
#79, #88 — each had a REAL observation and a WRONG mechanism, because the shipped rationale
lived in a comment adjacent to the code rather than in the artifact the symptom pointed at.
Acting on any of the three filed diagnoses would have made things worse: reverting a
correct security guard, reversing a deliberate use_exclude, and removing a leak detector the
code comments call load-bearing. Verify the mechanism before implementing the fix.

Consumer-facing status: the destructive regression is closed (#78 stopgap, 108->103 entries,
zero self-deleting remain) and the defer surface exists (F20, closed after blocking
compliant deferral across two sweeps). What remains is #79 — 11 shipped artifacts, one a
priority-0 baseline, citing a rule the USE tier deliberately never receives. Proposal 68
carries three dispositions with their costs; it is loom's call, not this repo's.

D2 is closed, and its asymmetry is recorded rather than smoothed over: #78 got a stopgap
because that is a deletion of wrong lines; #79 did not because it would have been an
invention of canonical content. "Stopgap + proposal" was applied where it made sense, not
mechanically to both.

D1 is ratified but BLOCKED, and the block is stated rather than worked around: both #86 and
#87 add only the inbox YAML, so the rule texts the graft needs (+306 / +229) are in neither
PR. Recommending Option A — relay both as one deduplicated entry preserving the agreement
(both independently cut the same unsound commit-ratio heuristic) and the disagreement (the
reachability scoping) — because loom is the classifier and the disagreement is the most
valuable content in the pair.

Deferred-quality backlog is EMPTY, and for the first time today that is a true statement
about the backlog rather than an artifact of a missing label.
